tabs.tab_title: Do I need to book in advance?
tabs.tab_content: You can book by phone (064-654-2666), LINE (jenny5667) or Facebook, or simply walk in. Open daily 09:00–21:00.
Regular prices: hands 250, feet 300, cat-eye 350 THB. During promotions from 200 THB with free cuticle care.

tabs.tab_title: What is included in the foot spa?
tabs.tab_content: Our 10-step foot spa (499 THB) covers up to the knee: salt and milk soak, scrub, mask and wrap, cuticle care, heel buffing, lotion, massage and hydrating mist.

tabs.tab_title: Can you remove gel done elsewhere?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Removal only 100 THB, removal with a new set 50 THB, PVC removal with a new set 100 THB.

settings.title: About Nail Me, nail salon in Surat Thani

settings.editor: Nail Me is a nail salon next to San Chao Market in central Surat Thani, offering gel polish, PVC nail extensions, nail art, a 10-step foot spa, a 9-step hand spa and blow-dry. Our idea is simple: a luxury salon with lovely prices — clear prices on the board and aftercare you can count on.
Open daily 09:00–21:00 · 285/6 Na Mueang Rd, Surat Thani 84000.
